description:
Add a buy, sell, deposit, withdrawal, dividend, short, or cover to a portfolio.

    A short names the stock. qty is the shares sold short. price is the sale
    price per share. A cover names the stock. qty is the shares bought back.
    price is the price per share. Neither uses $CASH. A short while long, a
    cover larger than the short, a sell larger than the long, and a buy while
    short come back as the terminal's 400. Do not rewrite that error into a success.

    A dividend names the stock, not $CASH. qty is the shares, price is the
    amount per share and must be greater than 0, and date is the pay date.
    Cash increases on a long and decreases on a short. The share count does
    not change. The open cost of a long drops by the part still held. A
    short's open credit shrinks. The closed slice is realized P&L.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID
        symbol: Stock symbol (e.g. "AAPL"). For deposit/withdrawal use "$CASH"
            (aliases "CASH" / blank are normalized to "$CASH").
        side: "buy", "sell", "deposit", "withdrawal", "dividend", "short", or "cover"
        qty: Number of shares (or cash amount for deposit/withdrawal)
        price: Price per share, or the dividend amount per share
        date: Trade date, or the dividend pay date (YYYY-MM-DD)
name: add_transaction
title: Add portfolio transaction
